terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: FastAPI backend + static frontend on http://localhost:8080 (elevchatt + guardian.html). Requires Ollama reachable at OLLAMA_URL for live chat.
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && cd backend && OLLAMA_URL="${OLLAMA_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:11434}" MODEL_NAME="${MODEL_NAME:-hermes3:8b}" uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
